correctness.rationale: In char 2 the square of any degree-2 omega vanishes because diagonal wedges square to zero and commuting cross terms cancel. Alternating normal form gives omega=sum_i e_i wedge f_i. In one 2-dimensional pair, multiplication maps degree0 1 to degree2 e_i f_i and leaves two degree1 classes, local homology polynomial 2t (not t); tensor-field Kunneth yields (2t)^r(1+t)^(n-2r). Total kernel/image quotient dimension 2^(n-r) and rank (2^n-2^(n-r))/2 determines Jordan blocks. Alternating rank-2r forms counted by radical Grassmannian times GL(2r,q)/Sp(2r,q), giving formula. Independently exhaustive GF(2) homology for n=3,4,5 and n4 counts [1,35,28] for r=0,1,2, 1096 finite checks; general proof is algebraic.

value.rationale: Left multiplication by a quadratic element is a canonical family of square-zero endomorphisms of the full exterior algebra. The exact all-rank graded homology and Jordan parameter-fiber counts are natural structural invariants in finite-field exterior algebra beyond a single small-case table.

final_claim: Over any F_(2^e), n>=2 and bivector omega with alternating coefficient rank 2r, left wedge multiplication squares to zero, has graded homology polynomial 2^r t^r(1+t)^(n-2r), Jordan sizes 2/1 with multiplicities 2^(n-1)-2^(n-r-1), 2^(n-r), and exact Gaussian/symplectic frequency for each rank.
limitations: Uses classical symplectic normal form and Kunneth, no claim these ingredients are novel.
